result:
If I could change the world in one way, I would ensure that every person has access to quality education—regardless of their background, location, gender, or socioeconomic status.

Education is foundational: it empowers individuals to think critically, solve problems, make informed choices, and contribute meaningfully to society. It reduces poverty, fosters innovation, promotes health and gender equality, and builds more resilient, peaceful communities. When people are educated, they’re better equipped to understand one another, bridge differences, and work together toward common goals.

By unlocking human potential at scale, universal quality education could ripple outward, helping to solve many of the world’s other challenges—from climate change to inequality—through informed, compassionate, and collaborative action.
